summary: Iter31 — Redesigned 'Post a Job' page + backend new fields (site_project_type, worker_skill_level). Backend: 5/5 pytest tests PASSED (client & contractor post with new fields, backward-compat without new fields, worker 403, list-jobs regression). Frontend: Full end-to-end verified on mobile viewport (390x844) for both Client (9000000001) and Contractor (9000000003). All 15 required testIDs present on Post page. Validation errors 'Please select Site / Project Type' and 'Please select Worker Category' render correctly. Worker Category searchable dropdown contains SKILLS from theme.ts (verified: Aluminium Window Installer, UPVC Installer, Marble Polisher present; Marbal Ghisai Worker absent). Skill Level dropdown lists all 4 EXPERIENCE_LEVELS (Full Trained, Semi Trained, Helper, Site Supervisor). Successful submit shows 'Job posted ✓' and navigates to /(tabs)/activity for both roles. Newly-posted jobs visible on My Jobs with UPVC Installer / Aluminium Window Installer skill labels. No regressions to seeded jobs listing.
critical_code_review_comments: post.tsx passes `worker_skill_level: skillLevel || null` — backend accepts Optional[str]; works correctly. Consider omitting the key instead of sending null for cleaner payloads (cosmetic).
Field validation order: title/description/location checked before site_type; ordering matches expected UX and validation strings match spec exactly.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed jobs via API (Client + Contractor). No user seeding needed; used existing demo accounts.
